name: Decision Pre-Mortem
description: A forward-looking risk session that assumes a decision failed and works backward to prevent avoidable failure.

sections.title: Decision Under Review
sections.instruction: State the proposed decision, owner, deadline, and what success is expected to look like

sections.title: Imagined Failure Scenario
sections.instruction: Describe the fictional future where the decision failed, including symptoms, affected groups, and consequences

sections.title: Failure Drivers
sections.instruction: List reasons participants believe the decision could fail, grouped by evidence, uncertainty, or intuition

sections.title: Blind Spots
sections.instruction: Capture assumptions, missing voices, weak data, incentives, or constraints that may be underweighted

sections.title: Tripwires & Early Warnings
sections.instruction: Define leading indicators that would show the decision is drifting toward failure

sections.title: Preventive Moves
sections.instruction: List changes, experiments, mitigations, or decision constraints that reduce failure risk

sections.title: Decision Confidence
sections.instruction: Summarize whether confidence increased, decreased, or stayed the same, and why
